name: 2026-09-crypto-donchian-breakout
hypothesis: A Donchian channel breakout on six-hour candles (buy a close above the prior 80-bar high, sell a close below the prior 40-bar low, 15% disaster stop, no target, no trail) holds long enough that the 1.0% round trip stops mattering, and loses LESS than holding the same nine coins across a full window. Backtested on 517 stored days (2025-04-22 to 2026-09-21): +$78 net at $100/coin against -$79 for holding; with the bot's break-even invariant applied, +$128. It beat holding in the two crash folds and lagged in the two rally folds; it lost in the choppy fold. Expected profile: roughly one trade in three wins, average winner ~2.5x average loser, holds of two to four weeks. The SMA crossover it replaces won one in five and could not clear costs on any timeframe.

config.exit_invariant: discretionary exits blocked below break-even; stop-loss exempt
config.state: fresh state files, $1000 simulated cash per coin; prior SMA-era state and trade CSVs archived, not deleted

success_criteria.primary: pooled net vs buy-and-hold over the same window > 0 (lose less in a down market, or make more in an up one)
success_criteria.note: Nine coins are highly correlated; treat pooled counts as ~2.4x the independent evidence, as for stocks.
success_criteria.not_a_criterion: win rate. The backtest says 30-50%; a HIGH win rate here would mean the exits were tightened.
success_criteria.watch_for: (1) any trade closed by TAKE_PROFIT or TRAILING_STOP means the profile was changed — stop. (2) trades held past 40 bars below the channel low with no stop hit is the invariant holding losers; expected, but if average loss exceeds 10% the stop is too wide for this basket.
success_criteria.power_caveat: At ~11 trades per coin per year this run cannot confirm a small edge in months. It can rule out a disaster and check that live behaviour matches the backtest's trade rate (~1 entry per coin per 5 weeks).

stopping_rule: Stop at 2027-01-15 OR 20 effective trades, whichever is later. No configuration change before then except a defect that stops trades executing or makes an exit unable to fire. Any change to channel length, stop, target or trailing restarts the clock and voids this registration.
notes: Chosen over RSI mean reversion, trend-filter and momentum-rotation classes in backtest_crypto_classes.py. Neighbouring parameters (60/30, 100/40, daily 15/7 to 25/12) were all positive, so this is a plateau, not a tuned point. Operator preference was for consistent small wins; the data says that profile is what costs kill on this venue, and the 8% take-profit test is recorded in the profile comment.
